notes: 2025 refresh terms: $795 fee ($195 per authorized user); The Edit credit calendar-year from Jan 1, 2026; several partner credits expire 2027-2029.

entitlements.name: Annual travel credit
entitlements.limits: Up to $300 in statement credits per account anniversary year, applied automatically to travel purchases; the covered portion earns no points.
entitlements.source_excerpt: up to $300 in statement credits for travel purchases each account anniversary year. Purchases that qualify will not earn points.

entitlements.name: The Edit hotel credit

trigger.channel: prepaid (Pay Now) The Edit booking via Chase Travel

entitlements.limits: Up to $250 per prepaid booking, max $500 per calendar year (started Jan 1, 2026); 2-night minimum stay; covered portion earns no points. Per-booking cap, not a half-year split.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Receive a statement credit of up to $250 for each prepaid booking with The Edit, up to $500 annually. Two-night minimum.

entitlements.name: Dining credit (Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables)

merchants: Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables restaurants on OpenTable
trigger.channel: purchase made directly with a participating restaurant

entitlements.limits: $150 Jan-Jun and $150 Jul-Dec. Must be identifiable as a direct restaurant purchase; gift cards, merchandise, third-party processors and delivery apps don't qualify.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Get up to $150 in statement credits from January through June and again from July through December for a maximum of $300 annually when you dine at restaurants part of the Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables

entitlements.name: StubHub / viagogo credit
entitlements.limits: $150 Jan-Jun and $150 Jul-Dec, through Dec 31, 2027. Gift cards excluded; UK-event purchases can't be made via stubhub.com.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Get up to $150 in statement credits from January through June and again from July through December for a maximum of $300 annually for StubHub and viagogo purchases through 12/31/2027. Activation required.

entitlements.name: Apple TV + Apple Music subscriptions
entitlements.limits: One-time activation on chase.com or the Chase app by June 22, 2027; primary cardmember gets at least 12 months of each from activation. Pauses an existing paid Apple subscription. Not a statement credit.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Get complimentary subscriptions to Apple TV and Apple Music for a minimum of one year when activated by June 22, 2027, a value of $324 annually.

entitlements.name: DashPass membership
entitlements.limits: Complimentary 12-month DashPass; activate by Dec 31, 2029 by enrolling the card on DoorDash/Caviar. Not a statement credit.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Complimentary DashPass membership, a $120 value for 12 months. ... Activate by 12/31/29.

entitlements.name: DoorDash monthly promos
entitlements.limits: Up to $35/month: one $15 promo on any qualifying order plus two $10 promos on non-restaurant orders (grocery, essentials). Requires the card-linked DashPass; unused value forfeits monthly; no rollover; through Dec 31, 2029. In-app discount, not a statement credit.
entitlements.source_excerpt: DashPass members now get up to $35 each month to spend on DoorDash – including a $15 monthly promo on any qualifying DoorDash order and two $10 promos each month

entitlements.name: Lyft ride credit

trigger.channel: Lyft app with the card as payment

entitlements.limits: Up to $10/month in in-app ride credit, through Sep 30, 2027. In-app credit, not a statement credit.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Lyft members can get access to up to $10 in monthly in-app credits, up to $120 annually, to use on rides through 9/30/2027.

entitlements.name: Peloton membership credit
entitlements.limits: $10/month statement credit on eligible Peloton memberships, max $120/year, through Dec 31, 2027.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Get $10 in statement credits per month on eligible Peloton memberships through 12/31/2027, for a maximum of $120 annually. * Activation required.

entitlements.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS fee credit

trigger.channel: paid directly to DHS or an authorized enrollment provider

entitlements.limits: One statement credit of up to $120 every four years for the first application fee charged. Cadence enum has no 4-year option; value is per 4-year cycle (~$30/yr annualized).
entitlements.source_excerpt: Receive one statement credit of up to $120 every four years as reimbursement for the application fee charged to your card.

entitlements.name: $250 The Shops at Chase credit ($75k spend)
entitlements.limits: Unlocked by $75,000 spend in a calendar year; available for the rest of that year and the following calendar year (max $500 available if earned in consecutive years). Threshold-triggered, not a fixed cadence.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Spend $75,000 each calendar year and unlock status and credits ... $250 Credit for The Shops at Chase

entitlements.name: $500 Southwest Chase Travel credit ($75k spend)

trigger.channel: Southwest flights booked via Chase Travel

entitlements.limits: Unlocked by $75,000 spend in a calendar year; usable for the rest of that year and the following calendar year; covered portion earns no points. Threshold-triggered, not a fixed cadence.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Spend $75,000 each calendar year and unlock status and credits ... $500 Southwest Airlines Chase Travel credit

entitlements.name: 8x Chase Travel (incl. The Edit)
entitlements.limits: Travel Designers/FROSCH bookings earn 8x only if booked directly through Chase Travel. Purchases covered by the travel or Edit credit earn no points.
entitlements.source_excerpt: 8x points on all purchases through Chase Travel, including The Edit

entitlements.name: 4x flights booked direct
entitlements.source_excerpt: 4x points on flights booked direct

entitlements.name: 4x hotels booked direct
entitlements.source_excerpt: 4x points on hotels booked direct

entitlements.name: 3x dining
entitlements.source_excerpt: 3x points on dining worldwide

entitlements.name: 1x all other purchases
entitlements.source_excerpt: 1x points on all other purchases

entitlements.name: 5x Lyft rides
entitlements.limits: Total 5x on Lyft rides through Sep 30, 2027; excludes gift cards, car rentals, fees and other Lyft products.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Plus, earn 5x total points on Lyft rides through 9/30/2027.

entitlements.name: 10x Peloton equipment
entitlements.limits: Eligible equipment/accessory purchases over $150, through Dec 31, 2027, 10x applies to up to $5,000 in total purchases; no apparel, gift cards, non-US or HSA/FSA Truemed checkout.
entitlements.source_excerpt: earn 10x total points on eligible Peloton equipment and accessory purchases over $150 through 12/31/2027.

entitlements.name: Points Boost (up to 2x value)

trigger.channel: select hotels (incl. The Edit) and flights via Chase Travel

entitlements.limits: Points redeemed at up to 2 cents each on rotating select offers; base value 1 cent. Unit is a redemption multiplier, which the unit enum doesn't cover, so unit is null.
entitlements.source_excerpt: With Points Boost, your points are worth up to 2x on top booked hotels, including The Edit, and flights with select airlines through Chase Travel.

entitlements.name: Chase Sapphire Lounges + Priority Pass Select

merchants: Chase Sapphire Lounge by The Club

entitlements.limits: Cardmember plus up to two guests; extra guests $27 each per visit. Physical Priority Pass card needed (digital wallet card not accepted). Access subject to capacity.
entitlements.source_excerpt: access to any Chase Sapphire Lounges by The Club and 1,300+ Priority Pass TM airport lounges worldwide with up to two guests

entitlements.name: Air Canada Maple Leaf Lounges & Cafés

trigger.channel: departing on a Star Alliance flight

entitlements.limits: Cardmember plus one guest at participating lounges in Canada, the US and Europe; guest fee applies at US lounges; Montreal (YUL) lounges and Signature Suites excluded.
entitlements.source_excerpt: 1 guest each to Air Canada's network of Maple Leaf Lounges and Air Canada Cafés across participating locations in Canada, the U.S. and Europe, when departing on a Star Alliance

entitlements.name: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite
entitlements.limits: Through Dec 31, 2027; activate by linking an IHG One Rewards account on chase.com or the Chase app.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Get complimentary IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite Status with your Sapphire Reserve card through December 31, 2027.

entitlements.name: World of Hyatt Explorist ($75k spend)
entitlements.limits: Unlocked by $75,000 calendar-year spend; held for the rest of that year and the following year; link Hyatt account.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Benefits include: World of Hyatt Explorist Status

entitlements.name: IHG One Rewards Diamond Elite ($75k spend)
entitlements.limits: Unlocked by $75,000 calendar-year spend; rest of that year plus the following year; auto-activates if Platinum Elite was already linked.
entitlements.source_excerpt: IHG One Rewards Diamond Elite Status

entitlements.name: Southwest Rapid Rewards A-List ($75k spend)
entitlements.limits: Unlocked by $75,000 calendar-year spend; rest of that year plus the following year (expires Dec 31).
entitlements.source_excerpt: you, as the primary cardmember, will be eligible for Southwest Rapid Rewards A-List status for the remainder of the calendar year in which you qualify through the following calendar year

entitlements.name: The Edit property benefits

trigger.channel: The Edit booking via Chase Travel

entitlements.limits: $100 property credit, daily breakfast for two, Wi-Fi, room upgrade and early check-in/late check-out when available; varies by property.
entitlements.source_excerpt: $100 property credit, daily breakfast for two, complimentary Wi-Fi, a room upgrade and early check-in/late check-out

entitlements.name: Reserve Travel Designers
entitlements.limits: Custom itinerary service Chase values at up to $300 per trip; no dollar credit.
entitlements.source_excerpt: This personalized service is valued at up to $300 per trip.

entitlements.name: Primary auto rental collision coverage
entitlements.limits: Decline the rental company's CDW and pay the full rental with the card; up to $75,000 theft/collision; secondary inside the US for New York residents.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Coverage is primary and provides reimbursement up to $75,000 for theft and collision damage for most rental vehicles in the U.S. and abroad.

entitlements.name: Trip cancellation / interruption
entitlements.limits: Up to $10,000 per covered traveler and $20,000 per trip for prepaid, nonrefundable fares/tours/hotels.
entitlements.source_excerpt: you can be reimbursed up to $10,000 per covered traveler and $20,000 per trip for your pre-paid

entitlements.name: Trip delay reimbursement
entitlements.limits: Common-carrier delay over 6 hours or requiring an overnight stay; up to $500 per covered traveler for meals, lodging etc.
entitlements.source_excerpt: If your common carrier travel is delayed more than 6 hours or requires an overnight stay, you are covered for unreimbursed expenses, such as meals and lodging, up to $500 per covered traveler.

entitlements.name: Lost luggage reimbursement
entitlements.limits: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler; NY residents limited to $2,000/bag and $10,000 per trip.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for the cost to repair or replace checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged or stolen

entitlements.name: Baggage delay insurance
entitlements.limits: Up to $100/day for up to 5 days for essentials when bags are delayed over 6 hours.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Reimburses you up to $100 a day for up to 5 days for essential purchases like toiletries and clothing when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

entitlements.name: Travel accident insurance
entitlements.limits: Up to $1,000,000 accidental death/dismemberment when common-carrier fare is paid with the card.
entitlements.source_excerpt: When you pay for your air, bus, train or cruise transportation with your card, you are eligible to receive up to $1,000,000 in accidental death or dismemberment coverage.

entitlements.name: Emergency evacuation and transportation
entitlements.limits: Up to $100,000 for medical services and transport after injury/illness on a trip 100+ miles from home.
entitlements.source_excerpt: injured or become sick during a trip 100 miles or more from home that results in an emergency evacuation, you can be covered for medical services and transportation up to $100,000.

entitlements.name: Emergency medical and dental
entitlements.limits: Up to $2,500 with a $50 deductible on trips 100+ miles from home.
entitlements.source_excerpt: sick or injured while you're 100 miles or more from home on a trip, you can be reimbursed up to $2,500 for medical expenses, subject to a $50 deductible.

entitlements.name: Roadside assistance
entitlements.limits: Up to $50 per service event, up to 4 events per year.
entitlements.source_excerpt: you can call for a tow, battery assistance, tire change, locksmith or gas. You're covered up to $50 per incident 4 times a year.

entitlements.name: Purchase protection
entitlements.limits: Damage or theft within 120 days of purchase (90 days for NY residents), up to $10,000 per item.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $10,000 per item.

entitlements.name: Return protection
entitlements.limits: Items the store won't take back within 90 days; up to $500 per item and $1,000 per 12-month period.
entitlements.source_excerpt: reimbursed for eligible items that the store won't accept within 90 days of purchase, up to $500 per item, $1,000 per 12-month period.

entitlements.name: Extended warranty
entitlements.limits: Adds 1 year to eligible US manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less, up to 4 years from purchase. Value = extra years.
entitlements.source_excerpt: Extends the time period of the manufacturer's U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from the date of purchase.

entitlements.name: No foreign transaction fees
entitlements.source_excerpt: Spend anywhere in the world with no foreign transaction fees on one of the most widely accepted global networks.
